textos.O Nexora coleta os seguintes dados para: Nexora collects the following data to provide the service: (a) platform access data (username and encrypted password); (b) OAuth access tokens of the Instagram accounts connected by the user; (c) public metrics of the managed accounts (followers, posts, engagement); (d) media uploaded by the user for scheduling (images and videos).
textos.Os dados coletados são utilizados exclus: The collected data is used exclusively for: operating the automation platform; authenticating and managing the Instagram accounts; scheduling and publishing content as configured by the user; monitoring account health and metrics.
textos.Não compartilhamos dados pessoais com te: We don't share personal data with third parties, except with Meta Platforms, Inc. for OAuth authentication and content publishing through the Graph API, as needed to provide the service.
textos.Os dados são armazenados em servidor ded: Data is stored on a dedicated server located in the European Union (Germany). We adopt technical security measures, including encryption of passwords and access tokens via HTTPS.
textos.Os dados são mantidos enquanto o usuário: Data is kept while the user has an active account on the platform. After the account is closed, the data is deleted within 30 days.
textos.Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Prote: In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018), the user has the right to: access their data; correct incomplete or outdated data; delete the data; revoke consent. To exercise these rights, contact us at contato@instaflow.pro.
textos.A plataforma utiliza cookies de sessão e: The platform uses strictly necessary session cookies for authentication. We don't use tracking or advertising cookies.
